page.notes: The running head is decorated and only partly legible; the title after "III." is illegible. Several words are uncertain: "uiuuis" (possibly a printing error for "uiuus"), "medofum" and "decederet" in the first line, and "nascerētur" with its macron. Italic lead-ins were kept as italic text, not as notes.
